capabilities.title: Build platforms from zero
capabilities.text: I set up the delivery pipelines and cloud infrastructure a new product needs, move monoliths to microservices, and take prototypes to product lines with real users.

capabilities.title: Introduce AI into production
capabilities.text: I've put LLMs and embeddings into production, backed by observability, evals and experiments.

capabilities.title: Modernise infrastructure
capabilities.text: I led the platform's move to Kubernetes, helped migrate it from GCP to Azure, and work with current .NET versions.

capabilities.title: Set technical direction
capabilities.text: I design distributed systems that stay up and scale when they need to, and build a culture where quality is built in from the start, not patched in after.
